sloka: एवं तु विलपन् दीनो भरत: स महायशा: ।नन्दिग्रामे ऽकरोद्राज्यं दु:खितो मन्त्रिभि: सह ॥ २.११५.२२॥
transliteration: evaṁ tu vilapan dīno bharata: sa mahāyaśā: ।nandigrāme 'karodrājyaṁ du:khito mantribhi: saha ॥ 2.115.22॥

translations.english: Thus lamenting in desolation and grief, the illustrious Bharata lived in Nandigrama along with his counsellors and started ruling the kingdom.
